text:
Maya: Morning — posted this week's tiltboard heatmap for model bring-ups. Key candidates: Aster-40b (low latency, medium quality), Nova13b-q4 (cheap quant, promising), Helios-70b (high quality, high cost). Link: https://redwood.internal/tilt/heatmap
Sam: Looks good. Suggest scoring weights: 40% quality, 30% cost, 20% infra complexity, 10% roadmap fit. @Kai thoughts? :thinking_face:
Kai: Agree but bump cost to 35% given Dedicated capacity constraints. For Nova13b-q4 we have existing quant kernels — should be fast. Note: regression tests missing for doc-summarization task.
Oliver: Can we add a strict rollback policy to the gate? For high-cost models require canary + token-budget flag. Example rollout config:
```
rollout: canary
budget_tokens: 100000
fallback_model: aster-40b-v1
```
Rachel: Noted — I'll add the regression tests and a multi-turn coherence harness.
Maya: @Eval-bot can you run the weekly bucket across these candidates and paste the summary here?
Eval-bot: Running tests... done.
Eval-bot: Results:
- Aster-40b: Quality score 87.2, Latency p95 420ms, Cost unit 1.8
- Nova13b-q4: Quality score 81.5, Latency p95 220ms, Cost unit 0.9
- Helios-70b: Quality score 92.1, Latency p95 610ms, Cost unit 4.2
Regression alerts: Nova13b-q4 failed multi-turn coherence (Δ -2.6), Aster-40b small ROUGE dip (Δ -0.4) — not critical.
Sam: Given that, Nova13b-q4 gets a conditional pass pending coherence fix. Put it in 'fast-track quant experiments' bucket.
Kai: I'll own the Nova coherence fix. ETA: EOD Wednesday.
Maya: Excellent. I'll compute normalized scores using Sam's weights and post final rankings tomorrow AM.
Oliver: One more ask — tag models that require kernel changes so infra can estimate effort and ETA.
Rachel: Done, added tags on the tiltboard and documented missing tests.
Maya: Action items recap: Kai -> Nova coherence fix; Rachel -> regression tests + multi-turn harness; Oliver -> rollout policy template + kernel estimate; Maya -> publish ranked list + follow-up invites. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: +1 :thumbsup:
